heading: New Tax Regime: 5 Ways to Reduce Your Tax for AY 2026-27
tldr: The new tax regime offers lower tax rates but limits traditional deductions, leading to a common misconception that no tax saving is possible.
Salaried individuals can still claim a Standard Deduction of ₹50,000 under the new regime from AY 2024-25 onwards.
Employer contributions to your National Pension System (NPS) account are deductible under Section 80CCD(2).
Donations to specified funds and institutions under Section 80G can provide tax relief, subject to certain limits.
Interest paid on a housing loan for a let-out property remains deductible, though rules differ from self-occupied homes.
caption:
Thinking the new tax rules mean no tax saving for you? Think again! Many believe they can't save tax under the new regime, but that's not true. There are still smart ways to lower your tax bill. Discover five simple methods, like standard deduction and NPS, that can help you keep more of your hard-earned money. Read our article to find out how.
